_about: Variant 1 arena constants. Single source of truth for the arena kernel (mage-core). Every number is authored and must be confirmed by the headless simulations named in the wave cards; feel is owner-only.

tierClock.fiction: The collar's runes loosen one by one; a perfect absorb feeds the collar and cracks the next rune early.

perfect.rule: the ward was raised (fresh press) no more than windowS before the hit resolves
perfect.inputTimestampCompensation: the TV judges by the phone input's clock-corrected timestamp, up to graceS late
feedback: white ring flash on the TV
double haptic pulse on the phone

absorb.twoAxis: Timing (the window) is the same for everyone and never scales with stats; Nerve scales the magnitude (drain and return). A stat never widens the window.

threatLanguage.magic: element colour, soft glow, shrinking impact ring: ABSORB it
threatLanguage.physical: white/steel, hard edge, no glow: ROLL it
threatLanguage.unblockable: black core with a jagged red rim and a crackle sound: LEAVE the area or BREAK the cast with a staff strike
